moodys.citation_text: March 2024 article 'Credit agencies downgrade Northern Light's rating' confirms multi-notch fall from BBB tier; subsequent BDN article noted 'In March, Northern Light was at a BBB rating, four grades higher than the current rating' (current = Ba3). Implies Baa1/BBB+ tier early 2023.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch not referenced for Northern Light. Moody's and S&P are the active raters.

outcome_class_rationale: FALLEN ANGEL: Moody's executed multi-notch downgrade Baa1 -> Ba3 (estimated 4+ notches) over Mar-Oct 2024 plus negative outlook Jan 2025. S&P executed multi-notch BBB+ -> BB (~5 notches) by Feb 2025. Both crossed IG/sub-IG boundary. Active DSCR covenant violations in 2022 and 2024 (waiver received). $156M operating loss FY24.

new_actions.rationale: Robust turnaround; strong position as key rural healthcare provider in northern and central Maine. Operating losses reduced from $156M (FY2024) to $15M (FY2025).
Performance improvement; Ba3 revenue bond rating affirmed; outlook revised negative→stable.
